issue: Old Money / Work shopping generation can return too few compatible cards or reject an unusable model selection.
diagnosis: Catalog supported three product-unique looks, but the five-look AI shortlist removed compatible alternatives.
Ranking all 24 options was rejected during real-provider experiments: invented, malformed and empty IDs. None of those experiments was deployed.

fix.behavior: Build a jointly compatible, validated displayed deck before bounded AI ranking. Reject unknown, repeated or missing selection IDs. Preserve style, composition, budget, anchor and product gates. Single-card selection unchanged.
fix.outputScope: Multi-card curated requests return the displayed target (three), rather than five shortlisted alternatives.

limits: Controlled active catalog pool and temporary trial accounts; not the screenshot account.
Production checks had no entered budget or weather; budget/style branches also covered by regression tests.
Native signed-in UI not rechecked: Mac locked and original simulator signed out.
Not exhaustive category coverage, provider reliability guarantee, sustained capacity evidence or 10,000 DAU certification.
Local source has older unrelated differences from hosted package; deployment preserved all other hosted files.
